title: US–China rivalry, critical technology, trade, and energy security
discussion_signal: The program connects tariffs, trade deficits, critical technologies, US–China rivalry, rare earths, semiconductors, AI competition, energy security, and shipping disruption. It frames short-term deals as potentially distinct from unresolved structural rivalry.
linked_research_question: How economic exposure, technology competition, energy routes, trade policy, and state capacity combine into strategic dependence or room for action.
limits: Curated news discussion rather than a public-opinion sample
Expert framing does not establish future state behavior
No causal effect of tariffs, trade deals, or energy disruption is measured
